implementation_baseline.message: feat: add bounded planner critic correction

scope.boundary: proposal-only Planner response correction through the existing Host admission and validation boundaries
scope.critic_route: explicitly supplied independently admitted L1 Provider pool
scope.change: A response-contract failure may invoke one independent planning Critic, whose corrected proposal is returned to the existing RootPlanningValidator

failure_boundaries.model_output_invalid: one bounded independent Critic correction may be selected
failure_boundaries.security_egress_authority: remains Host/Human-owned and is not retried by Critic
failure_boundaries.unknown_external_effect: remains reconciliation-only and is not replayed

verification.focused: 7 Planner Critic adapter, independent pool, and request-correlation tests passed

interpretation: The existing Planner shadow can now be explicitly composed with a separately admitted L1 planning Critic for one observed response-contract failure. The Critic remains proposal-only and cannot validate, integrate, approve, mutate, or promote a Gate. This is contract and local composition evidence; it is not live Planner recovery, AR1 completion, or Phase 8 LIVE_ACTIVATION evidence.
